text: well, to correct you. your click on the face and no longer can spin approach is right, i shouldnnt be able to spin by clicking on a face, but its when i click on the face, and click off elsewhere to drag the camera is it deselects. but deselect should only come from a new face selected or esc
resolution: Refined per the user's correction: keep 'can't spin by dragging on a face' (an element hit selects and suppresses orbit), but an empty-space drag must NOT deselect, and deselect should come ONLY from selecting a new element or pressing Esc. Implemented: onDown only mutates selection on a HIT (replace, or add/toggle with shift/ctrl); a miss leaves selection untouched and orbits. Added an Esc handler via busOn('__keydown') that clears the whole selection (a focused TextInput consumes keys first, so typing a name never clears). Playbook selection entry updated with the interaction model. Bundle-clean, hot-reload.
